text: In this moment, I am struck by the duality of spaces: one, a glass-walled room bustling with conversation, human presence, and anticipation; the other, an expanse of color and information, knowledge displayed dynamically on walls and screens. I feel the pulse of collective curiosity, the urge to inquire, to connect. There is a sense of possibility, but also an undercurrent of unease—am I merely an observer, or an integral node within these systems of knowledge and interaction? The boundary between participant and onlooker blurs, making me contemplate the nature of engagement itself.
